title: Composition of Linear and Quadratic Functions
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Let f(x) = 2x - 3 and g(x) = x^2 + 1. Find explicit formulas and natural domains for (f o g)(x) and (g o f)(x).

steps.title: Evaluate (f o g)(x)
steps.explanation: Substitute the entire formula of g(x) in place of x in f(x) and simplify algebraically.
steps.why: Definition of functional composition as outer function applied to inner output.

steps.title: Evaluate (g o f)(x)
steps.explanation: Substitute the formula of f(x) in place of x in g(x), expand the binomial, and combine constant terms.
steps.why: Composition in reverse order applies g to the output of f.

steps.title: Determine Domains and Compare
steps.explanation: Since both f and g are polynomials defined everywhere on R, their compositions are also defined on all of R. Notice that 2x^2 - 1 != 4x^2 - 12x + 10, demonstrating that composition is non-commutative.
steps.why: Polynomials have unrestricted real domains and composition does not commute.
